messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the public holidays in Canada that typically create long‑weekends in 2023. (Note that some holidays are provincial/territorial only, so the “long‑weekend” effect may vary depending on where you’re located.)

| Date | Holiday | Typical Long‑Weekend Effect |
|------|---------|-----------------------------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Monday – New Year’s Day + Sunday (if observed) |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday – Family Day + Sunday |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday – Good Friday + Saturday (and sometimes Sunday) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (most provinces) | Monday – Victoria Day + Sunday |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Tuesday – Canada Day + Monday (or Wednesday if observed) |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Monday – Labour Day + Sunday |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Monday – Thanksgiving + Sunday |
| **November 11** | Remembrance Day (most provinces) | Monday – Remembrance Day + Sunday |

If you’re planning trips around these dates, you’ll likely find that many of them turn into extended breaks because the holiday falls on a weekday adjacent to a weekend. Happy planning!
